title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Deligne record with Paper 88 fixed French working layer
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so that Deligne material can be cited and revised independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing: one combined English translation draft PDF, 90 individually downloadable original-language reference PDFs with human-readable paper titles, and separate paper-level English translation supplements for Papers 84, 85, 87, and 88. The artifact ZIP contains individual English PDFs, TeX/source files, fixed French working layers where available, reports, render checks where present, and compact provenance packages.

Status at a glance. [##########] 90/90 original-language paper PDFs staged; [#####-----] 46/90 English-ready or working-English PDFs found locally or promoted as separate paper-level supplements; Papers 84, 85, 87, and 88 now have full working English translation supplements with TeX in the artifact ZIP. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX by automated transcription systems, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status, not by internal run name.
notes: Standalone Deligne record linked to the main public manuscript corpus. Latest update replaces the Paper 88 French working layer in the artifact ZIP with a corrected version while preserving the English translation supplement.
